decisions.reason: As a design and finish extension of the core drainage range, it draws on existing production, sales and specification knowledge, so the firm can exploit it with little new learning and is likely to retain it despite some fashion-related demand risk.

The pump-assisted range is more complex and support-intensive than standard drains, but it still rests on the firm's drainage know-how and in-house R&D, so accumulated learning should favor continuation unless demand stays niche.
This tileable floor drain fits the firm's established capabilities, installer relationships and barrier-free bathroom trend very closely, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.

The stainless steel design grate is a close adjacent product that leverages the firm's design-engineering strengths and broad portfolio logic, so absorptive capacity is high and exit risk remains low.

Although the pump-drain shower channel adds technical and service complexity, it benefits from knowledge gained on earlier drainage and pump-based products, giving the firm a solid basis to improve and keep it on the market.
